about_the_game:
Kona & SnowRabbit

Nicknamed “the troublemakers of the art world,” the rookie ice art duo Kona and SnowRabbit quickly rise to fame by pulling pranks on veteran artists. But their fame does not last long as the furious Palette Gang strikes back and turns their home into chaos. To reclaim their stolen artworks, comics, and pride, the two mischievous artists head for the gang’s exhibition hall.

Cool and Thrilling "Freeze Action" Combat

Shoot, freeze, and smash. Enjoy fast and exhilarating battles that let you sweep through waves of enemies using simple and intuitive controls. Freeze your foes and shatter them with style in this uniquely satisfying freeze action experience.

Stylish Characters and Comic Book Presentation

From the mischievous ice artist duo to the talkative snow rabbit, colorful characters bring humor and charm to every scene. Speech bubbles, exaggerated expressions, and lively comic style effects create a vibrant playable comic atmosphere.

Chapters Filled with Distinctive Bosses

Each chapter features a boss inspired by a unique art theme, set within their own exhibition hall. Every confrontation offers fresh challenges, creative designs, and memorable moments that showcase the duo’s frozen artistry.

  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060

short_description: The mischievous art duo, Kona and SnowRabbit, rise to fame by pranking veteran artists until the furious “Palette Gang” strikes back. With their home in ruins, the two troublemakers set out to reclaim their stolen pride and masterpieces.
